superseded_runs.reason: AMD PBO exhaustive transport fault tests exceeded the 90-second whole-suite CTest budget on macOS and Windows; no assertion failure was reported. Increased the test suite budget to 240 seconds, retained production protocol timeouts, and reran all workflows at one new SHA.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: All production/build sources match the tested cloud artifact except the listed retained user extensions. Post-build changes are documentation and static caller evidence; runtime and analysis tests were in the tested commit.

limits: No real hardware setting, PBO effect or stability measurement has been verified.
Only Shimada family 1Ah/model 08h at PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 is admitted for the new setting API.
Scalar is a shared firmware setting, not a per-core/CCD setting. Firmware acceptance alone is insufficient; an exact query readback is required. No automatic retries, rollback or PBO/OC enable.
Per-core/CCD PM telemetry layout remains unresolved. Other AMD profiles, native PM transport, Intel server controls and board-specific settings remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a full application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; Secure Boot and actual register settings were not tested.

cautions: Ghidra addresses are original ELF addresses plus 0x100000; file-offset identity was checked.
Original instructions supersede missing or incorrect mixed-ABI pseudo-code arguments.
The function named MP1_C2PMSG uses the RSMU address triplet on the traced Shimada branch.
Scalar commands and encoding use pinned primary source contracts; the original Fmax/rails trace alone is insufficient.
No real firmware table, original hardware initialization, physical core mapping or hardware effect was verified.

legacy-amd-pbo-transactions-local.json.scope: Full pinned PBO constructor/setter and MP1 instructions; synthetic PCI lookup/access, globals, locks, delay and family. Neither firmware nor hardware behavior is validated.
observations: Shimada PCI 153a constructor sets flag +11h to one; subsequent Fmax uses 70h.
The other Fmax flag path uses 6Dh; neither setter waits for completion.
Rails input mirrors one zero input, packs two low 9-bit fields and sends 61h then 5Dh.
A8 uses RSMU addresses despite the MP1_C2PMSG function name; failed response still publishes the output word.
Every injected original PCI failure permits later accesses; this is evidence of original behavior, not a recommended protocol.

legacy-amd-pm-percore-local.json.scope: Original constructor and mode-4 core/CCD loops, with synthetic topology, transport and C++ boundaries; calibration assumed complete. CCD inputs are deliberately not asserted to correspond to the table version. Storage labels/ranges do not prove physical mapping, units, or a valid firmware layout.
